text:
Zoe: sleepy poll: one song and one quick comic to close the day. no long explanations, just titles. 
Mark: song: 'Night Drive' - Chromatics. comic: 'Daytripper' (one chapter = instant ache).
Priya: song: 'Sea, Swallow Me' (This Mortal Coil) + comic: 'Shortcomings' (bite-sized and hits).
Dani: song: 'Rhubarb' (Aphex Twin) looped. comic: 'The Killing Joke' for that late-night noir kick.
Zoe: love the variety. tiny bonus: anyone doing a nostalgic comfort rewatch this weekend?
Mark: rewatching 'Amelie' feels like cocoa for the brain.
Priya: 'Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me' if you want to be unsettled but mesmerized.
Dani: meme: "me at 1:42am deciding whether to read spoilers or savor the mystery" :eyes:
sound-bot: added Chromatics - 'Night Drive' and Aphex Twin - 'Rhubarb' to the "random team night" collaborative playlist. link: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/4example :robot_face:
Zoe: ok new rule: tomorrow everyone reports back with one 2-sentence take on what actually helped them unwind. tiny accountability.
Mark: challenge accepted. goodnight all. :crescent_moon:
Priya: night! may the comics be short and the songs long.
Dani: goodnight, filing 'Daytripper' into my weird-weather shelf.
